shortDescription: Visitor arrivals to New Zealand increased 8.5% year-on-year to 256,638 in July 2026, accelerating from an 8.1% rise in June, driven largely by gains from Australia.The increase was the largest in four months, with the number of visitor arrivals being the highest since April.

children: Visitor arrivals to New Zealand increased 8.5% year-on-year to 256,638 in July 2026, accelerating from an 8.1% rise in June, driven largely by gains from Australia.
The increase was the largest in four months, with the number of visitor arrivals being the highest since April.

title: New Zealand Tourist Arrivals Rise the Most in 4 Months
